title: Compare manifests within their declared Git-blob hash domain
trigger_preconditions: A manifest declares path-filtered Git blobs while Windows checkout bytes may use a different line-ending domain.
failure_signature: The first pre-commit review compared Git-blob SHA-256 values to checkout bytes and reported two tooling-index mismatches.
candidate_workaround: Inspect object-id, exact Git-blob bytes, and checkout bytes separately; validate each field only in its declared domain.
recurrence_guard: Never compare a Git-blob SHA-256 field directly to unnormalized checkout bytes on Windows.
rollback: Give the failed aggregate zero pre-commit review credit and retain its mismatches before a corrected domain-aware review.
scope_boundary: Owner-local manifest-domain verification only; no full-suite, scientific, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
